validation.title: The request is invalid
validation.detail: Check the submitted data and try again.

unauthorized.title: Authentication is required
unauthorized.detail: Sign in to your account to continue.

forbidden.title: You are not allowed to do this
forbidden.detail: This action is not available for your account.

not_found.title: Resource not found
not_found.detail: The requested resource does not exist or was removed.

conflict.title: The request conflicts with the current state
conflict.detail: The resource changed; reload and try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many requests
rate_limited.detail: Wait a moment before trying again.

internal.title: Internal error
internal.detail: Something failed on our side. The team has been notified.
